parties.petitioner: Mohinder Singh (D) Thr. Lrs. and Another

summary: Urbanization notification under Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957 s.507(a) vis-à-vis applicability of Delhi Land Reforms Act, 1954; rural-to-urban conversion effect on mutation proceedings; interpretation of Acts' harmonization; gaon sabha dissolution under DLR Act s.150(3); right of tenure holders post-urbanization; High Court's finding that urbanized land ceases to be governed by DLR Act; SC upholds High Court's position on statutory non-applicability post-notification; possession dispute secondary to jurisdictional question.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned High Court judgment upheld; mutation proceedings under DLR Act declared non-est post urbanization notification; parties directed to seek remedies before appropriate urban jurisdiction forums.
